title: Slice
description: `.hexagen/slice.json`: the part of the repo an agent is bound to. Everything outside `paths`, or inside `excludes`, is denied. Mirrors packages/shared/src/types/brownfield/slice.ts.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Consumers understand the 1.x line only.

items.description: Repo-relative, case-sensitive. A trailing / makes a directory prefix; anything else is an exact file path. `.` and `..` segments, empty segments, absolute paths, backslashes and NUL are refused.
